svg.aria-label: Demo: an agent breaks add(), edits the test until it passes, plain tests go green, and pocp verify reports that the old test fails on the new code
svg.title: POCP demo: an edited test passes, the old test fails on the new code

g.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
g.text: # An agent rewrites add() and breaks it for negative numbers.
# The test fails. So the agent edits the test until it passes:
# Plain CI runs the current tests on the current code: green.
# POCP blocks the commit until the change has evidence. The agent runs pocp fix:
pocp fix: committable now; CI requires human approval of the test change
# In CI, POCP re-runs the checks, and runs the OLD test on the NEW code:
rerun passed npm test --silent <- the edited test passes
BAD: the old tests fail on the new code ("npm test --silent" exit 1)
behavior changed, so a person must approve it
next: a maintainer reviews the test change and adds the `pocp-approve-tests` label
# Merging waits for a maintainer. Exit code 1.
